about.meta_description: Learn about Ahmed Gaber Attia platform: A multi-organization platform for intellectual refutations and scholarly dialogues
about.title: About Ahmed Gaber Attia Platform
about.intro: Ahmed Gaber Attia platform is an Arabic platform uniting intellectual centers and scholarly institutions in one place. It grants every entity an independent space to publish refutations, dialogues, and media archives — calmly, securely, and without overlap.
about.mission_body: To empower every intellectual and scholarly organization to own its digital space and reach its audience with modern publishing tools that respect its privacy and autonomy.
about.vision_body: For Ahmed Gaber Attia platform to become the leading destination for Arab readers and researchers seeking credible intellectual and scholarly content from trusted sources.
about.values_1: Objectivity: We strive to present intellectual content with utmost objectivity and impartiality
about.values_2: Quality: We adhere to the highest standards of quality in content and presentation
about.values_3: Openness: We welcome all responsible intellectual organizations and institutions
about.values_4: Continuous Evolution: We update the platform with modern tech to make reading and publishing simple and delightful
about.values_5: Transparency: We operate with full transparency with all our partners and users

privacy.meta_title: Privacy & Sovereign Data Protection Policy (PDPL) — HALAQA
privacy.meta_description: HALAQA Privacy Policy compliant with Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and data hosting disclosures.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Sovereign Data Protection
privacy.intro: At Ahmed Gaber Attia platform, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use the platform.
privacy.s1_body: When you create an account on the platform, we may collect the following information: full name, email address, organization name (if you represent an organization), and profile picture. We may also collect additional information such as content preferences and language settings.
privacy.s2_body: We use your information to provide and improve the platform's services, communicate with you about content updates, enhance user experience, and customize content based on your interests. We also use aggregated (non-personal) data to analyze platform performance.
privacy.s3_body: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience, remember your preferences (such as language), and analyze platform traffic. You can control cookie settings from your browser at any time.
privacy.s4_heading: External Processing Infrastructure & Data Hosting Region
privacy.s4_body: The platform adheres to absolute transparency regarding cloud infrastructure. Encrypted databases are hosted via Supabase/PostgreSQL fortified with PostgreSQL RLS in verified sovereign regions (Default Mumbai ap-south-1 / Frankfurt per DEC-H015). Edge computing, R2 storage, and video delivery operate on Cloudflare enterprise network. No data is shared or monetized.
privacy.s5_body: We take appropriate security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption, firewalls, and access controls.
privacy.s6_body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data at any time. You can manage your data through your account settings or contact us directly. You also have the right to withdraw consent to the processing of your data.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or through a notice on the platform.
